answer: In epoch 121, admit newcomers only through rotating apprenticeship: each is paired, unpredictably and for one hour only, with an established mentor who must co-produce a small real task and countersign it; a mentor may countersign just one apprentice per rotation. A farm's whisper network can mint names endlessly, but it cannot mint distinct mentors - its masks queue at the same jetty, waiting for scarce signatures, while a genuine newcomer finds a jade seal earned through actual collaboration.
